name: vip-mobiles
description: VIP Mobiles - Mobile Store E-commerce & Management Platform

scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace=packages/shared && concurrently -n API,WEB -c blue,yellow "npm run dev --workspace=backend" "npm run dev --workspace=frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=packages/shared && npm run build --workspace=packages/db && npm run build --workspace=backend && npm run build --workspace=frontend
scripts.start: concurrently -n API,WEB -c blue,yellow "npm run start --workspace=backend" "npm run start --workspace=frontend"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=packages/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace=packages/db && npm run typecheck --workspace=backend && npm run typecheck --workspace=frontend
